new.brief: Creates a new numeric sorter using the given `expression`.
new.md:
Creates a new numeric sorter using the given `expression`.

Smaller numbers will be sorted first. You can call
[`NumericSorter.set_sort_order()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.NumericSorter#method:set_sort_order) to change this.

doc.md:
Sorts items numerically.

To obtain the numbers to compare, this sorter evaluates a
[`Expression`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Expression).

get_expression.brief: Gets the expression that is evaluated to obtain numbers from items.
get_expression.md: Gets the expression that is evaluated to obtain numbers from items.

get_sort_order.brief: Gets whether this sorter will sort smaller numbers first.
get_sort_order.md: Gets whether this sorter will sort smaller numbers first.

set_expression.brief: Sets the expression that is evaluated to obtain numbers from items.
set_expression.md:
Sets the expression that is evaluated to obtain numbers from items.

Unless an expression is set on `self`, the sorter will always
compare items as invalid.

The expression must have a return type that can be compared
numerically, such as %G_TYPE_INT or %G_TYPE_DOUBLE.

set_sort_order.brief: Sets whether to sort smaller numbers before larger ones.
set_sort_order.md: Sets whether to sort smaller numbers before larger ones.

expression.brief: The expression to evaluate on items to get a number to compare with.
expression.md: The expression to evaluate on items to get a number to compare with.

sort-order.brief: Whether the sorter will sort smaller numbers first.
sort-order.md: Whether the sorter will sort smaller numbers first.
